Our Vision

Our Vision

A world where no one loses their sight to preventable causes — where every individual, in every community, has access to the eye care they need to live, work, and thrive with dignity. We envision an India where geography is never a barrier to sight, where rural and urban communities receive equal access to quality ophthalmic care, and where empowered local health workers sustain eye care well into the future.

Our Mission

Our Mission

To deliver compassionate, high-quality eye care to underserved communities through screening, surgery, and accessible vision centers — while building a skilled local workforce that ensures lasting, community-led eye health. We pursue our mission through four pillars: Eye Screening Camps, Cataract Surgeries, Vision Centers, and Skill Development Training.

Who We Serve

Communities Where Need Is Greatest

Our work is focused on communities where the need is greatest and access is most limited. We go where mainstream healthcare does not.

  • Rural Villages Remote hamlets with no nearby eye care facility or specialist within reach
  • Children in Schools Government school students with undiagnosed vision impairment affecting learning
  • Elderly Individuals With untreated cataracts, diabetic retinopathy or age-related eye conditions
  • Daily Wage Workers Marginal farmers for whom vision loss directly means loss of livelihood
  • Women & Girls Disproportionately affected by eye disease and less likely to seek care independently
Support Our Mission
Stories of Change
Meet Savitri Devi
Village Kursi, Uttar Pradesh
"I had not seen clearly for three years. The cataract had stolen everything — I could not cook, I could not recognise my grandchildren's faces. When the Nain Taara camp came to our village, I was terrified. But three days after the surgery, I opened my eyes and the world came back. I wept. My family wept. I am free again."
SD
Savitri Devi, 64

Our Numbers

This is the Impact We've Created

THE ISSUE

Over 12 million Indians live with preventable blindness. For millions of children and elders in rural areas, sight loss means losing their livelihood, education, and independence.

Learn More

OUR WORK

We deploy free eye camps, mobile vision units, and trained volunteers deep into underserved communities. Every patient receives expert care — at zero cost, with full dignity.

Here's How

OUR IMPACT

We've restored sight to over 5,000 patients, conducted 50+ free screening camps, distributed 2,000+ spectacles, and mobilised 300+ trained volunteers across 8+ states.

Our Process

From outreach to restored sight.

We identify underserved communities, conduct awareness campaigns, set up free screening camps, and provide immediate and follow-up care. No paperwork. No cost. Just care.

01

Community Identification

Ground teams map villages with limited healthcare access and high prevalence of untreated eye conditions.

02

Free Screening Camp

We deploy ophthalmologists, optometrists, and trained volunteers to conduct comprehensive eye exams on-site.

03

Treatment & Surgery

Patients needing surgical intervention are transported to our partner hospitals. All costs borne by the Foundation.

04

Follow-up & Spectacles

Post-operative care and free prescription spectacles ensure lasting results and improved quality of life.

Common Questions

FAQ

Every rupee donated to Nain Taara Welfare Foundation goes directly towards our programs — eye screening camps, cataract surgeries, spectacle distribution, and vision centers. We publish annual reports with full financial disclosure so you can see exactly where your contribution goes. A small portion covers essential administrative costs required to sustain operations.
Nain Taara Welfare Foundation has obtained 80G certification from the Income Tax Department. All donations will be eligible for tax deduction under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act. We will issue receipts accordingly. Please check back for updates.
Absolutely. We have two volunteering tracks: Onsite Support (joining camps on the ground for coordination, patient care, and logistics) and Skill-Based Volunteering (remote contribution in communications, grant writing, legal, HR, finance, or technology). Please fill the contact form and mention your preferred track and availability.
We welcome Corporate CSR partnerships and offer structured programs with clear impact metrics, reporting, and public recognition. Whether you want to sponsor a specific camp, fund surgeries, or run an employee volunteering program — we can design a partnership that meets your CSR mandate. Contact us at support@naintaara.ngo.
Yes. We accept in-kind support including prescription spectacles, diagnostic equipment, medicines, and mobility support for camp operations. Please get in touch with us first so we can assess your contribution and coordinate logistics appropriately.
Sign up to our newsletter below to receive regular updates on our camps, impact stories, new programs, and fundraising opportunities. You can also follow us on social media for field updates and patient stories.
